Clean up temp files afterward.

environment_constraints: Python 3.9 only (no 3.10+ syntax like `X | None` in annotations at runtime unless from __future__ import annotations; prefer Optional[...] or plain dict). pip is at /usr/bin/pip3 (21.2.4). No internet assumptions for the app itself but pip install needs network. Do NOT touch git config; commit locally, never push.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING in repo. Authoritative conventions come from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: (1) NO DTOs / no schemas.py — routers take `payload: dict = Body(...)` and validate required fields + enum values from constants.py manually; repositories return `dict(row)` from sqlite3.Row. (2) All timestamps are Manila localtime via SQL `datetime('now','localtime')` — rely on schema column defaults; use the same expression for date comparisons. (3) One patient per hub: patient.id has CHECK (id = 1); the profile is a single upserted row, never a second. (4) constants.py values MUST match the schema CHECK constraints exactly.
key_patterns: FastAPI APIRouter per feature in app/features/<name>/router.py. Role enforcement via middleware/dependencies.py: get_role reads headers X-Role (patient|caregiver) and X-Caregiver-Id; require_caregiver is a dependency that 403s patient-mode and invalid caregivers. Settings stored in the `settings` table as JSON strings in the `value` column keyed by `key`. Dashboard returns FULL LISTS of rows (not counts) and an activity_summary that is ENGAGEMENT-ONLY (no score/rating/percentage/correct-incorrect) — a hard product constraint from PRODUCT.md and ARCHITECTURE sections 10 and 11.
